headline: As of 2026-10-27: 34,700,315 early/mail ballots cast nationally across 48 of 50 states, D+10.9 cast-ballot lean.
bullets: 34,700,315 early/mail ballots cast so far across 48 states reporting.
Across party-registration states, ballots cast lean D+10.9 by registration.
Most ballots cast: Texas (5,124,764), California (3,382,645), Florida (3,301,713).
